description: Hardening invariants that are decisions on bytes: pal:// URI validation (item 5), rejection of low-order X25519 public keys (item 1), the FIPS 203 modulus check of ML-KEM encapsulation keys (item 7) and datagram reassembly (item 3).

x25519.rule: an all-zero shared secret, or a library error, rejects the key

mlkem.rule: every 12-bit coefficient of the first 1152 bytes must be below 3329

reassembly.name: fragmentsInAnyOrderComplete
reassembly.description: Three fragments arrive as 2, 0, 1; the frame is returned with the last one

reassembly.name: identicalRetransmissionIsHarmless
reassembly.description: The same fragment twice changes nothing

reassembly.name: conflictingDuplicateDropsTheMessage
reassembly.description: First write wins; a different payload for the same index drops the whole message, so the late fragment starts a new entry

reassembly.name: inconsistentTotalDropsOnlyThatPacket
reassembly.description: A packet with another total for the same message_id is refused and the legitimate message still completes

reassembly.name: nonFinalFragmentMustBeFullSize
reassembly.description: A short fragment that is not the last is refused

reassembly.name: fragmentLargerThanTheLimitIsRefused
reassembly.description: A final fragment above 1200 bytes is refused

reassembly.name: entryExpiresAfterFiveSeconds
reassembly.description: The second fragment arrives 5000 ms after the first: the first is gone and the second starts a new, incomplete entry

reassembly.name: sourcesNeverMixFragments
reassembly.description: The same message_id from another source with another payload is a different message, not a conflict

reassembly.name: perSourceCapOfSixteenEvictsTheOldest
reassembly.description: Seventeen incomplete messages from one source evict the first one: the second message still completes, and the late fragment of the first one only starts a new incomplete entry

reassembly.name: globalCapOf128EvictsTheOldest
reassembly.description: 129 incomplete messages from 129 sources: the first one was evicted, the last one completes

credit.name: oneMebibyte
credit.description: The requester grants 1 MiB: the responder stops after 1 MiB

credit.name: sixtyFourMebibytesIsClampedToSixteen
credit.description: A grant of 64 MiB is clamped to 16 MiB

credit.name: noCreditSendsNothing
credit.description: A grant of 0: nothing is sent until CREDIT arrives

credit.name: negativeCreditIsZero
credit.description: A negative grant is clamped to 0

credit.name: creditMessagesAddCredit
credit.description: A grant of 1 MiB, then CREDIT of 1 MiB and of 2 MiB

credit.name: aCreditMessageIsClampedToSixteen
credit.description: A grant of 0, then CREDIT of 1 GiB: at most 16 MiB are sent

credit.name: creditBelowOneBlock
credit.description: A grant of 100000 bytes is less than one 256 KiB block: a block is sent whole, so nothing is sent

credit.name: creditOfOneAndAHalfBlocks
credit.description: A grant of 393216 bytes: one whole block is sent

credit.name: creditBelowOneBlockThenTopUp
credit.description: A grant of 100000 bytes, then CREDIT of 162144 bytes: together exactly one block
